Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner decided to prioritize the USA theatrical release dates for comparison when the task did not require such a narrow scope. Instead of simply comparing the global release dates of Xenoa (August 22, 2007, in the Philippines) and Divorce Invitation (2012 in the USA), the Planner unnecessarily complicated the task. This led to redundant queries and reliance on the USA release date for Xenoa, which was never found and was irrelevant to solving the problem. The correct approach was to use the widely available global release data from earlier steps, which clearly showed Xenoa was released earlier.
